findings.title: Dış örtü, iç ayrımların örtülebilmesine bir model olur
findings.claim: Gece, gün ışığının açtığı alanı örten hareket olarak, daha sonra donatılmış insanın kendi ayrımlarının da örtülebilmesini düşünmeye imkân verir; bu ilişki geceyi başlı başına kötülük ilan etmeden kurulur.
findings.mechanism: Focus carrier ٱلَّيْلِ ... يَغْشَىٰهَا ordinary night and covering asıl anlamını taşır; night-over-day and layered-darkness contexts make the covering an applied exterior operation, while 91:7-9 supplies an already formed interior whose discernment can be obscured and then answerably restored.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can keep literal nightfall in view while seeing why an outer covering gives a concrete model for the later possibility that an informed inner field loses its distinctions.
findings.containment: The packet supports an exterior-to-interior analogy, not a claim that night causes mental or moral obscurity, that the feminine pronoun has a proven single antecedent, or that the focus verb means literal fainting here. The wide-walk citation ن ف س/B013 has no registered branch and remains an unresolved contextual attribution.

epistemic.reason: The trusted cross-run record supplies exact focus anchors, while the inner-discernment trigger and its 91:9 qualification come from legacy_unbound contextual evidence; the analogy is therefore grounded but explicitly inferential.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: gündüzün karşıtı olan gece ve onun karanlığı
branch_activations.facet_statement: Gündüzün karşıtı olan zaman bölümü gecedir; tek bir gece veya birden çok gece olarak sayılabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: ٱلَّيْلِ carries the ordinary night, the time opposite day.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 13:3 supplies a separately expressed night-over-day covering relation.
branch_activations.activation: The independent cosmic alternation lets the focus night be heard as the active exterior field in which covering can be applied, not as an isolated time label.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Nightfall becomes a visible outer model for a field whose contents can be disclosed and then covered.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not turn the focus into a claim about a specific night, a proven antecedent, or a moral quality belonging to night itself.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey başka bir şeyle örtülür ve üstü kapatılır.
branch_activations.carrier: يَغْشَىٰهَا carries an active covering movement directed onto a feminine object.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 24:40 supplies layered darkness that covers sight and leaves the field barely visible.
branch_activations.activation: The separately supplied physical occlusion makes the focus verb's covering action perceptible as an applied veil, which can then serve as an intelligible outer image for obscuration.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The night is not only present; it acts as a cover laid over what is there.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not thereby assert the sea-darkness scene or say that its object is sight; that context supplies a model for the operation only.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir durum kişinin anlayışını veya bilincini kapatır ve kişi baygın hale gelir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus covering action carries the supplied awareness-closing edge of the verb family.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 91:7-8 supplies a formed inner self with opposed contents and discernment, while 91:9 supplies purification as the response that keeps the analogy reversible.
branch_activations.activation: The later interior trigger meets the focus cover at the same active verb: an outer cover becomes a way to picture distinctions in an already endowed self being obscured.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Alongside literal nightfall, the ayah makes the possibility of covered understanding newly intelligible.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is retained at its awareness-covering edge; the focus is not asserted to mean literal fainting, and night is not made the cause of moral failure.

findings.title: Örtmenin kuşatıcı bela yönü
findings.claim: يَغْشَىٰهَا ile taşınan örtme hareketi, bağımsız kuşatıcı felaket imgeleriyle temas ettiğinde, her yanı saran bir belanın da anlaşılacağı bir basınç kazanır; gece sahnesi yine gece sahnesi olarak kalır.
findings.mechanism: The focus verb supplies the covering carrier, while 44:11 and 29:55 independently supply affliction that covers people from every side; their contact activates the registered overwhelming-cover facet at the focus.
findings.reader_payoff: The ordinary cover gains a bounded sense of force and reach: what covers can, in another activated setting, surround a whole field as an affliction.
findings.containment: The relation does not identify the focus night with punishment, the Last Day, or disease. It retains the core whole-enclosing facet and leaves specialized B002 uses tied to the contexts that name them.

epistemic.reason: The citable cross-run support anchors B002 at the focus, but its source wording is a possibility and the connection rows are discovery nominations; the bounded relation is retained with qualification rather than treated as a local paraphrase.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Büyük bir olay veya sıkıntı, etkilediği kişileri her yandan sarıp kuşatır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus imperfect verb carries the act of covering its object.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 44:11 and 29:55 supply separately attested covering-affliction scenes whose reach is explicitly adverse and all-enclosing.
branch_activations.activation: When those contexts meet the focus carrier, covering is heard not only as a surface laid over something but as an effect that can surround the whole field.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The night-covering carries a qualified latent pressure toward overwhelming enclosure.
branch_activations.boundary: No actual punishment is assigned to 91:4, and no specialized Last Day or disease use is imported without its own context.

findings.title: Geceyi bir geliş olarak duyma
findings.claim: يَغْشَىٰهَا fiilinin gelip uğrama yönü, gecenin alanın üzerine gelen ve sonra çekilebilen bir uğrak gibi duyulmasına imkân verir; böylece zaman cümlesi, sıradan örtmenin yanında geçicilik de taşır.
findings.mechanism: The focus verb is an exact carrier for the coming-upon facet, and the supplied night-in-motion contexts at 89:4 and 81:17 provide independent movement and passing-phase triggers.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel darkness as an event that arrives over the scene, rather than only as a permanent condition possessed by it.
findings.containment: This is a bounded, branch-driven personification of arrival and yielding. It does not claim literal visitors, a permanent owner of the night, or a replacement of the plain night-covering reading.

epistemic.reason: The citable publication supplies the focus branch but carries a reject grade in its serialized finding record; independent connection notes and the legacy wide-walk corroboration provide a valid dynamic trigger, so the relation is retained as qualified rather than ranked by that label.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Hareket eden kişi, hedefteki kişiye ya da yere gelir ve uğrar.
branch_activations.carrier: يَغْشَىٰهَا carries a movement that reaches its feminine object.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 89:4 and 81:17 supply night in motion and a changing course as independent temporal images.
branch_activations.activation: The moving-night contexts meet the focus verb's coming-upon facet and make the covering an arrival within a cycle.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Night can be heard as a passing visitor-like phase that covers the field and leaves room for renewed disclosure.
branch_activations.boundary: The event-like reading remains an attributed resonance; the focus does not assert human visitors or settle the pronoun's antecedent.

findings.title: Örtmenin insanî gizlenmeye uzanan yankısı
findings.claim: Odaktaki gece örtüsü, daha sonra gizleme ve aldatıcı örtülülükle yan yana geldiğinde, aynı örtme işleminin kozmik bir düzen içinde masum kalırken insan tarafından saklanmak ve yanıltmak için taklit edilebileceğini görünür kılar.
findings.mechanism: The focus night and covering carriers are connected to the supplied 91:10 concealment image and the 91:11/91:14 deceptive-covering image; the later context returns to the focus operation and gives it a morally ambivalent human extension.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why night is not itself a moral symbol: the contrast lies between an exterior cosmic covering and a person's later decision to hide or abuse covering.
findings.containment: The source supplies an analogy or imitation relation, not causation, moral equivalence, or a verdict that darkness is evil. The nominated context branches are used only at the ayah-level carriers explicitly named by the reader walk; no unprovided word-level analysis is invented.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk record supplies the branch names and same-surah context contacts but is legacy_unbound and explicitly describes the moral arrow as an inference; the full relation is therefore visible with its boundary exposed.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: gündüzün karşıtı olan gece ve onun karanlığı
branch_activations.facet_statement: Gündüzün karşıtı olan zaman bölümü gecedir; tek bir gece veya birden çok gece olarak sayılabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: ٱلَّيْلِ carries the night that follows the disclosed day-field.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 91:3 supplies the preceding disclosure against which the later covering is read.
branch_activations.activation: The ordered disclosure-and-covering pair gives the later human concealment context a neutral cosmic operation to imitate or abuse.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Night becomes the non-moral exterior form whose later human echo can be morally charged.
branch_activations.boundary: The pair does not prove that every later act has the same referent or that night itself carries human guilt.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey başka bir şeyle örtülür ve üstü kapatılır.
branch_activations.carrier: يَغْشَىٰهَا carries the direct act of placing a cover over its object.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The disclosure at 91:3 and the supplied concealment reference at 91:10 provide distinct stages for the same covering operation.
branch_activations.activation: The focus cover meets later hiding through the shared action of making what is present less accessible to view.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The plain cosmic cover also exposes the mechanics by which human concealment can be imagined.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet supports a structural analogy, not a claim that the cosmic night performs the later human act.

branch_activations.carrier: The 91:10 context is supplied as a hidden-insertion or concealment image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus verb supplies the separate covering action that returns this context image to 91:4.
branch_activations.activation: A context act of hiding meets the focus cover as an attributed human extension of making something inaccessible or unseen.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The night-covering can be understood as the neutral exterior pattern later echoed by chosen concealment.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch remains ayah-level reader evidence; no unprovided context morphology or exact coreference is claimed.

branch_activations.carrier: The supplied 91:11 and 91:14 context references carry deceptive variegation as a covering-like image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus covering movement provides the distinct operation through which the context image returns to 91:4.
branch_activations.activation: The focus cover and later deceptive surface meet in the possibility that concealment can preserve an appearance while hiding what matters beneath it.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The night-covering acquires a qualified shadow of humanly abused concealment and deception.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not make the focus night deceptive or morally corrupt; the branch is a context-bound image named by the supplied reader walk.

findings.title: Örtmenin bütünüyle üzerine çökmesi
findings.claim: Odaktaki örtme hareketi daha sonra bütünüyle ortadan kaldırma imgesiyle temas ettiğinde, gece yalnız kapatan değil, sınırlar ihlal edildiğinde bütün alanı üzerine alabilecek bir kuvvet gibi de duyulur; bu tehdit düzeyi literal gece sahnesini yerinden etmez.
findings.mechanism: The focus verb carries the overwhelming-cover facet, 91:14 supplies the complete-eradication carrier, and 53:54 supplies an independent overwhelming-cover parallel that connects the early cover to later total overtaking.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel how the same enveloping motion may remain a quiet cover in the focus while acquiring a destructive edge when a later context supplies eradication and violence.
findings.containment: The relation is a legacy_unbound contextual inference, not a claim that night is punitive or that 91:4 already contains the whole 91:14 event. The accompanying ط غ ي/B002 citation has no registered branch and is not given an invented gloss or separate activation.

epistemic.reason: The reader walk supplies both the focus branch and the 91:14 eradication contact, while the connection supplies a separate overwhelming-cover parallel; the source is legacy_unbound and its destructive arrow is explicitly inferential.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Büyük bir olay veya sıkıntı, etkilediği kişileri her yandan sarıp kuşatır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus covering verb carries an enveloping action that can be applied to its object.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 91:14 supplies complete eradication and 53:54 supplies an overwhelming covering scene as distinct later images.
branch_activations.activation: The destructive contexts make the focus covering action readable as a motion whose reach can become total when boundaries have been violated.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The quiet night-covering keeps a latent possibility of overwhelming enclosure in view.
branch_activations.boundary: No punitive result is assigned directly to the night in 91:4, and the later event remains a contextual return rather than a replacement sense.

branch_activations.carrier: The supplied 91:14 context carries the complete-eradication image attributed to damdama.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus covering occurrence is the separate earlier operation that receives this later destructive return.
branch_activations.activation: The later eradication carrier returns through the focus cover and sharpens its enveloping motion into total overtaking under a changed context.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The cover can be retrospectively felt as having a destructive edge without becoming destruction in the focus itself.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet does not license importing every late punitive branch into the focus; this activation is limited to the supplied 91:14 carrier and its stated return.

findings.title: Örtmenin olay gibi gelişi
findings.claim: يَغْشَىٰهَا fiilinin gelip uğrama yönü, 91:12 ve 91:13'teki uyandırma ve gönderme olaylarının bir sahneye sonradan gelen hadiseler gibi duyulmasına imkân verir; böylece ahlâkî kriz, insan seçiminin yanında insanın üzerine gelen bir karşılaşma olarak da görünür.
findings.mechanism: The focus coming-upon carrier is met by the supplied 91:12 and 91:13 context references, which the reader walk identifies with rousing or dispatch and sending; the focus verb is the return point.
findings.reader_payoff: The later crisis can be felt as an arrival that reaches a people, not only as an interior decision detached from what happens to them.
findings.containment: The source's ب ع ث/B002 and ر س ل/B001 citations have no registered branch matches; their supplied context roles are retained only as attributed rousing and sending evidence, without inventing branch glosses or claiming that night literally causes those events.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch is registered and the reader walk names the two context ayahs, but the event-to-event arrow and the cited context branches remain legacy_unbound and partly unresolved.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Hareket eden kişi, hedefteki kişiye ya da yere gelir ve uğrar.
branch_activations.carrier: يَغْشَىٰهَا carries the movement of reaching its object.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 91:12 and 91:13 contexts provide later rousing or dispatch and sending as distinct events arriving upon the people.
branch_activations.activation: Those events meet the focus coming-upon facet and let the covering clause frame later moral crisis as an arrival or visitation of events.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The ayah holds an event-like path from night arriving over its object to later crisis arriving upon a community.
branch_activations.boundary: The relation remains analogical and attributed; unresolved context-branch identities and the focus pronoun's antecedent are left open.

findings.title: Örtmenin etkin bir işlem oluşu
findings.claim: Gece, gündüzün açtığı alanın üzerine uygulanan bir örtme işlemi olarak kurulur; böylece karanlık yalnız ışığın yokluğu değil, görünen bir alan üzerinde gerçekleşen etkin bir dönüşüm gibi duyulur.
findings.mechanism: The focus night and covering carriers are set against the supplied disclosure reference at 91:3 and the independent night-over-day construction at 13:3; the repeated conditional structure keeps the movement eventive.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see darkness arriving as something done to a field that day had made visible, while the plain night-covering remains immediately recoverable.
findings.containment: The packet supports an applied-operation inference, not a claim that darkness is an independent substance, that the focus object is definitively 91:3's object, or that the night is morally adverse.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus carriers and the reversal cue are supplied, but the interpretation of darkness as an operation rather than absence is explicitly an inference from legacy_unbound wide-context evidence.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: gündüzün karşıtı olan gece ve onun karanlığı
branch_activations.facet_statement: Gündüzün karşıtı olan zaman bölümü gecedir; tek bir gece veya birden çok gece olarak sayılabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: ٱلَّيْلِ carries the ordinary night and its darkness.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 13:3 supplies a direct night-over-day construction as an independent cosmic comparison.
branch_activations.activation: The external construction makes the focus night perceptible as an agentive phase that reaches across a visible day-field.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Nightfall is heard as active concealment rather than only as absent daylight.
branch_activations.boundary: The comparison does not settle the focus pronoun's antecedent or replace the ordinary time reference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey başka bir şeyle örtülür ve üstü kapatılır.
branch_activations.carrier: يَغْشَىٰهَا carries an active cover placed over its object.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 91:3 supplies the preceding disclosure that the supplied wide-context record says the focus clause reverses.
branch_activations.activation: The adjacent disclosure-to-covering relation turns the verb into a visible operation acting on an already opened field.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The night does something to the field: it covers what had been exposed.
branch_activations.boundary: The reversal is structural evidence for an applied operation, not proof of a single shared referent or of moral darkness.

friction_notes: All twelve assigned HFT records are visible in the packet, but every one has empty anchor_evidence and no exact context ayah, word index, root, attributed role, or focus-return contact; they remain explicitly reviewed and rejected rather than silently omitted.

The reader-walk records are legacy_unbound. Their same-surah context branches are supplied at ayah-level references, so those activations remain qualified and do not claim unprovided context morphology or exact coreference.

Connection rows supply exact target Arabic and discovery notes but no target morphology; they are used as independent contextual triggers and not as standalone lexical proof. Their prior labels, including reject and no value, are preserved as provenance rather than treated as decisions.
The reader-walk candidates retain unresolved branch citations ط غ ي/B002, ن ف س/B013, ب ع ث/B002, and ر س ل/B001 in finding boundaries; no unregistered branch gloss is invented for them.

No uncandidate branch or connection supplies a stronger independent carrier-trigger-focus-return path than the retained findings; branches available only in the registry without a grounded contact remain unactivated without an exhaustive negative inventory.
